final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT orderslink AS c1, AVG(rebtotal) AS c2, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS c3 FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(c3) AS c1 FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.c1 AS c1, s1.c2 AS c2, s1.c3 AS c3, s1.c3 - s2.c1 AS c4 FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.c1 IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.c3 > s2.c1) SELECT AVG(c2), AVG(c3), AVG(c4) FROM s3
